notes.title: Introducing Casual Driving Mode!
notes.notes:
We've got [b]BIG[/b] news! 

Not only can you still enjoy the pulse pounding Arcade Mode that's guaranteed to be 80s hard, you can now embrace your [strike]evil[/strike] lazy side with a brand frickin' new game mode! Introducing... 

[h3][b]Casual Driving Mode[/b]![/h3] 

No time limit! 

No penalty for murdering civilians! 

Just endless unfettered [b]8-bit mayhem[/b] at your own pace. Siiiiick!! 

We've also made the leap from 32-bit to 64-bit to help ensure stability with the endless Windows OS updates. But, if you do encounter a bug, please let me know in the steam community forum.

notes.title: Update for Spring 2021!
notes.notes:
release notes for 1.2.0
* BRAND NEW VEHICLE! Show your irreverent side with a new steampunk version of Night Jackal's vehicle, Anubis!
* LORE! LORE! LORE! Read the brand new COMIC BOOK series, released for the very first time! Ever! Read it here first for a limited time. And it's FREE with the game! 
* The variant black & white issue #1 also included with this build--but only for a limited time! 
* Each vehicle has its own unique gameplay! Classic is, well, classic mode. Dark is for those that want something more... moody. Punk is for the silly among us.
* New fancy colors and lighting! And other doodads and doodlebits to make your eyes smile. 
* So good we skipped over version 1.1. We cool like that. 
* …plus bug fixes and performance enhancements aplenty!
